name: N-methyl-N-allyltryptamine
summary: Methylallyltryptamine (MALT), also known as N-methyl-N-allyltryptamine, is a lesser-known psychedelic drug from the tryptamine family. It is a novel compound with very little history of human use. It is closely related to methylpropyltryptamine (MPT). The drug has been sold online as a designer drug. Very little information on the pharmacology or toxicity of MALT is available.
